capital_lines.basis: Actual beam concrete/rebar/tendons/anchorages, plus explicit fabrication labour, machine/QA and one overhead; rail and complete 8 kg fastener assemblies have own overhead, not a second beam uplift.
Four complete Class C bearing pad/plate/anchor/QA packages per span; no bearing design acceptance.
Separate nonzero Class C package for unresolved end joints, drainage and lifting interfaces.
Gravity-closed 200 kPa footing/pier volume times ingredient recipe; does not establish footing structural or geotechnical acceptance.
160 kg/m3 preliminary pad/pier detailing times dated CSO rebar; laps and bar schedule remain unresolved.
Declared support crew-hours times loaded two-shift hourly wage.
Nonzero formwork, excavation and construction-plant allowance per independent support.
All counted span stock tonne-km at declared haul; field rails shipped separately from bare concrete lifting piece.
Spans per active crane shift; hook rating at actual radius, ground support and temporary stability remain unverified.
Declared crew-hours per span at loaded two-shift wage.
One installation charge per two-rail TRACK metre; avoids charging the same track operation per rail metre.
Explicit 20 m supply-length rail butt joints, with separate weld/test process allowance.
Protected access/evacuation route budget, with platform overlap removed only as explicit cost continuity hypothesis; physical continuity unverified.
Declared extra cost reserve for unresolved additions; not extra measured stock or a structural pass.

limitations: Class C rail fabrication price uses rebar only as a cost scale, not a qualified rail material or process.
Four pads per beam, joints, walkway, excavation/formwork and machine prices are bounded package assumptions.
Two independent support lines are priced; shared-crosshead savings need a separately designed and costed adapter.
Crane capacity at radius, prestress transfer, fatigue, torsion, bearings, foundations and vehicle/stator clearance remain unqualified.
Factory buildings/tooling, stations, depot, land, utilities, launch equipment, fees, contingency and rolling stock are priced by the parent benchmark, not this adapter.

comparison_policy: Hold route, stations, offered peak capacity, comfort, daily service and horizon constant. Compare complete installed and whole-life estimates; physical acceptance is independent.
interpretation: Low/base/high are coupled planning sensitivities, not probability bounds. Cable is the analysis anchor, not an engineering selection or proven cheapest design.
limitations: Level synthetic route, ordinary shallow-foundation hypothesis, no major river bridge or tunnel design.
Installed mass, centre of gravity, reaction/coupler structures and added rotating inertia remain unresolved.
The journey is a kinematic target; integrated jerk, actual force/current/thermal maps, independent braking and protected turnbacks remain unqualified.
One-sided doors require a compatible platform/terminal layout. Platform continuity and construction access remain unverified.
Nominal 35 kW auxiliary duty is conditional; 50 kW stress needs revised charging/turnback/fleet. Grade samples can fail station-only coasting.
Vehicle residual cost accounts can overlap; no speculative overlap credit or shared-bogie saving is taken.
Cable/roller structures and LIM thrust uprating are provisional functional-package estimates, not manufacturing-ready designs.
Taxes/duties, project contingency and financing are explicit provisions, not legal or credit offers. Financing is separate from the installed-cost benchmark.
rate_basis: 2026 planning IQD with dated July CSO materials/wages and explicitly declared engineering package rates; USD translated at fixed observed CBI rate. No supplier-installed quotes.

calibration.evidence: First-party US catalogue observations. Bare equipment calibration only: no Iraq quotation, 50 Hz compatibility, railway duty or available-force acceptance.

currency.source_fact: CBI homepage displayed USD 1510 IQD; fixed translation rate, not a procurement FX guarantee.

capital_lines.basis: Selected vehicle stock plus residual accounts, factory process, delivery and final assembly, counted once for the purchased fleet; possible account overlap remains unresolved.

mass_case_repricing.policy: Reprice the linear residual-account material/process/overhead subtotal to factor 1.0; located stock, final assembly and delivery are unchanged. No overlap credit.

Declared extra cost reserve for unresolved additions; not extra measured stock or a structural pass.
One converter capacity budget per outgoing launch site; common per-kVA rate across mechanisms, with explicit efficiency, power factor and headroom.
Incremental transformer/switchgear/protection and installation per launch kVA. Auxiliary charging capacity is priced separately without another traction converter.
Motor-only catalogue-calibrated rate plus transmission/cooling/cabinet integration; converter is separate. No catalogue model is selected or qualified.
Rope and return-guide lengths plus drum/grip/trolley/anchors/guards package. Persistent coupling, fatigue, redundant stopping and release remain unqualified.
New boarding platform structures only; running beams/piers are in guideway. Asymmetric platform/door interfaces and evacuation design remain open.
Accessible access, lifts, passenger/fire/egress protection, station controls and fitout/installation packages. No accessibility requirement is removed.

Protected crossovers/approach and route communications allowance; two terminal boarding edges already supply two budget positions, so their platforms are not added twice. Conflict-free operations remain unproven.

One charging capacity package per boarding edge, with extra grid capacity priced once; no traction motor or traction battery onboard. Nominal charge balance is conditional on the unvalidated battery/charge map.

Project buildings, local benches/handling fixtures, precast moulds and concrete cells. Each labour position is not charged as a complete vehicle cell; hired machine use and purchased-component factories stay in unit prices. No second complete motor factory is added.
Sized storage tracks, trackbed/rails/fasteners, rail installation/weld/QA, covered maintenance bays, shop equipment, turnout and utility allowances; no generic full-depot charge per trainset.
Assumed partial public-corridor reuse, purchased depot/factory footprint and relocation allowance. No land rights, city valuation, surveyed utilities or major water crossing is established.
Component spares and commissioning; spare trainsets are already inside delivered fleet count, and vehicle delivery is not added twice.
One protected recovery asset budget per 15 route-km; tow capacity, access and response remain unqualified.
Project design, surveys, representative prototypes, independent engineering/safety review and integration testing provision; factory QA is already in component prices.
Unverified tax/duty cash allowance on vehicles and launch equipment. These percentages are budget hypotheses, not statements of Iraqi tax law.
Explicit contingency for unresolved installed detail, site and development scope; no physical requirement is waived by this allowance.

lifecycle_lines.basis: Required launch work plus active-fleet hotel load, declared losses and tariff; no regeneration credit or measured energy.
Covered station/control positions, two shifts and relief; maintenance staff are inside the maintenance provision.
Routine labour/consumables reserve excludes the scheduled asset replacements.
Train-km corrective/disruption reserve; no observed availability or fare revenue.
Standby budget for the separately purchased recovery assets.
Disjoint initial asset lines renewed at declared planning lives; complete vehicle resets service-account age.
Year-30 removal/disposal provision with no speculative salvage credit.

interface_holds: One-sided doors require compatible platform and terminal orientation/layout
Protected turnback, shared approach/departure resources and recovery remain unqualified

jerk_bound.scope: Necessary launch stroke only; not substituted into the constant-acceleration journey

jerk_launch_work.method: Exact polynomial convolution/integration of the three S-curve velocity phases; level track, zero wind

service.jerk_timing_profile_role: Equivalent acceleration matches S-curve time, stroke and end velocity for coast/brake timing only; its force/power/work are not used for equipment rating
service.journey_scope: Symmetric S-curve launch state followed by analytical natural coasting and constant-net-deceleration receiving brake; braking jerk is not modeled. Equipment rating uses requested peak-acceleration envelope. No available drive, braking or dynamic model is demonstrated.
service.mass_scope: Retained accounted mass plus declared added reserve; not complete installed mass or a certified lower bound. No reference hardware is silently removed.
service.schedule_margin_scope: Explicit planning recovery allowance on moving time only, not simulated slower motion or extra dwell/turnback
service.terminal_position_cost_basis: Additional positions beyond one basic turnaround position per terminus; do not double-count if station costs already include them.
service.terminal_turnback_definition: Per-end arrival-at-rest to next departure, including terminal dwell; no second terminal dwell or extra tail-clearance trip time added.
